capability: Browser input gesture primitives (shared technical module)
description: Shared technical module, not a business domain. Classifies raw browser input for editing surfaces: middle-button pointer detection, wheel gestures whose browser default (page zoom, history swipe) must be suppressed, the click-versus-drag threshold guard, outside-pointer and Escape dismissal for overlays, and the Pragmatic drag-and-drop draggable/droppable adapter. Canvas pointer routing (canvas-renderer), LiteGraph gesture handling (graph-canvas), and feature drop handlers stay with their owners.

characterizationScenarios.name: Pointer and click-drag classification distinguish middle-button pans and drags from clicks
Overlays dismiss on outside pointer and Escape while ignoring their own trigger
Pragmatic drag-and-drop adapters register droppables for canvas drops

compatibilityPromises: Inventory preserves existing exports and runtime behavior without granting public entry points or cross-module dependency permissions.
